config.grain_rationale: Each row is one current Victorian liquor licence (Licence Number unique per row) held by a licensee at a licensed premises; entity fields describe the licensee business, address fields the licensed premises.

record_id.rationale: Licence Number: 465/465 present and 465 distinct in discovery sample; identifies the licence record (not a business identifier).

fields.rationale: Column headed 'Licensee' — the registered holder of the licence, recorded in legal-name style (PTY LTD / LIMITED / City of X). Not a display name.
'Trading As' is explicitly the business/trading name.
Street address of the licensed premises.
4-digit AU postcodes (438/445); a few placeholder '0' values nulled.

constants.rationale: Victorian liquor licence register published by Liquor Control Victoria; all premises are in Victoria.

unmapped.reason: Licence identifier, not a business identifier; used only as record_id.
Licence type (General/On-Premises/Packaged Liquor etc.), not a licence type in the entity ontology; no valid target.
Licence condition text; no ontology target.
Local government area of the premises; no ontology target for LGA.
Administrative region of the premises; no ontology target.
Licensee postal (mailing) address, may be a PO box or interstate; not the premises address and not an entity attribute in this ontology.
Part of the licensee postal mailing address; not the premises locality.
Part of the licensee postal mailing address; not the premises postcode.

config.notes: XLSX: title/branding rows occupy the first 4 rows; header on row 5 (skip_rows=4). Sheet subtitle says 'Current Victorian Liquor Licences as of 31/08/2026' — snapshot currency date, but it is not a per-record stated value and observation.valid_from cannot be set as a constant, so observed_at falls back to resource metadata. No ABN/ACN column exists, so no entity.abn/acn mapping (licence numbers are 8-digit and fail both checksums — do not use). Licence Category does not state legal entity type, so entity.entity_type left unmapped (defaults unknown). Some Licensee values are individual person names (sole traders) — they are the licensee business here, not contact persons.
